name: obs-ollama-routes-go
notes: The full route table. There is no /metrics handler: the registered endpoints are /api/version, /api/status, /api/pull, /api/push, /api/tags, /api/show, /api/create, /api/blob, /api/ps, /api/generate, /api/chat, /api/embed, and the /v1 and /v1/responses compatibility routes. /api/ps is the only state endpoint and its response type ProcessModelResponse carries name, model, size, size_vram, context_length, expires_at - no timing, no queue depth, no KV usage.
